messages:
rachel: FYI new model bringup (atlas-7b q4_0) shows drop on our cross-lingual paraphrase promptset. float=0.845, q4_0=0.794. failing langs: hi, ar, pt. canary run id eval/1840001000.
omar: hmm. where are the failing sample ids? can we surface a quick triage export?
rachel: pulling low-confidence bucket now: s3://redwood-evals/ingest/xling_paraphrase_lowconf/*.jsonl. running a fast dedupe + language stratify.
tara: recommend we prioritize by both lang and low-token-coverage (cases where tokenized length >> char length). tokenization mismatch often sneaks in with quant kernels.
leo: no tokenizer changes in atlas-7b build. quant pipeline used per-tensor scaling with stochastic rounding. latency improved ~12%.
tara: ok run token_diff and token_coverage scan:
```
python tools/token_diff.py --model atlas-7b-float,atlas-7b-q4_0 --samples 2000 --out /tmp/atlas_tokdiff.json
python tools/token_coverage_scan.py --input s3://redwood-evals/ingest/xling_paraphrase_lowconf/ --out s3://redwood-evals/curation/coverage_report.json
```
labeler-bot: opened queue labelflow://queues/xling-qdrop-2026-03. estimated items: 1800. priority: hi, ar, pt. ETA human-only 48h.
omar: for dedupe use combined fingerprint + embedding-cluster (faiss) to avoid paraphrase-collapse. example command:
```
python tools/dedupe_faiss.py --input s3://redwood-evals/ingest/xling_paraphrase_lowconf/*.jsonl --emb-model embed-small --out s3://redwood-evals/curation/xling_qdrop_pool/ --cluster-thresh 0.86
```
rachel: proposal: 1) assemble 2k gold (min 400 per target lang) 2) keep synth <=15% (backtranslation only) 3) double-review 250-item holdout for stability metrics 4) rerun compare and stratify by lang + length.
tara: add flags {ambig,deid,synth,token-diff} during labeling so eval scripts can filter or bucket.
leo: I'll spin a canary with seq-len 1024 and memory-precision fallback for last 3 layers for one run. will post logs.
eval-bot: canary started by leo at 1840001000 : https://evals.redwood.internal/runs/1840001000. artifacts staging. :eyes:
labeler-bot: holdout created: s3://redwood-evals/curation/xling_holdout_double_v1/ (250 items, double-reviewed).
omar: after gold is in place run compare with per-lang buckets:
```
python evals/compare.py --baseline float --candidate q4_0 --gold s3://redwood-evals/curation/xling_qdrop_gold_v1/ --stratify buckets_by_lang_and_len.json --out /tmp/xling_qdrop_diff.json
```
rachel: decision rules: - if per-lang recall gap > 3.5% -> rollback and bisect. - if gap concentrated on tokenization-diff flagged items -> fix token mapping or apply tokenizer-aware fallback. - else try mixed-precision KV for affected layers.
tara: note: synthetic backtranslations must preserve named entities; tag synth items with synth and verify entity-preservation metric.
leo: kicking off dedupe+ingest now. will ping when queue is live and canary logs are available. :rocket:
eval-bot: canary finished at 1840001990 : artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-eval-artifacts/1840001990/
